context: A regular customer chats with a barista about the cost of living
purpose: Teach: 現金/値上げ/返済/公団/商標/稼ぐ/職務/突入

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今日も現金払いでお願いします。カードだとつい使いすぎちゃうから、最近は現金主義に戻したんですよ。
lines.en: Cash payment again today, please. I end up overspending with cards, so lately I've gone back to a cash-only approach.
lines.style: Warm middle-aged father, slightly weary tone, steady pacing, friendly familiarity with the barista.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: かしこまりました。実は来月から豆の料金値上げがありまして、一杯五十円ほど上がる予定なんです。すみません。
lines.en: Understood. Actually, starting next month there's a price increase on beans, so a cup will go up by about fifty yen. I'm sorry.
lines.style: Polite professional barista voice, gentle apologetic delivery, soft customer-service register.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ええっ、ここも値上げか。住宅ローン返済もまだ十年残ってるし、本当に家計が苦しいよ。
lines.en: What, here too? I still have ten years left on my mortgage payments, and honestly the household budget is really tight.
lines.style: Resigned sigh, candid fatherly grumble, conversational and unguarded with a regular's familiarity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お気持ちわかります。私の祖母も古い住宅公団の団地に長く住んでいて、年金だけでは厳しいとよく言っています。
lines.en: I understand. My grandmother has lived a long time in an old public housing complex, and she often says living on just her pension is rough.
lines.style: Empathetic barista, lowering voice to share a personal anecdote, warm conversational tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: わかるなあ。うちも子どもの学費があるから、最近は副業で稼ぐ同僚も増えてきてね。職務規定が緩くなったんだよ。
lines.en: I get it. We've got school fees too, and lately more coworkers are earning extra through side jobs. The work duty rules got loosened.
lines.style: Informative, slightly conspiratorial workplace gossip tone, leaning into the counter.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そうなんですね。実は私も自分のブレンドに商標を取って、いつか自分の店を持てたらって夢見てるんです。
lines.en: Is that so? Actually, I'm dreaming of trademarking my own blend and someday opening my own shop.
lines.style: Quietly excited, dreamy aspirational tone, sharing a personal goal with a trusted regular.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おお、それは素敵な夢だね。応援するよ。物価高もいよいよ最終局面に突入したって新聞に書いてあったし、頑張り時かもね。
lines.en: Oh, that's a lovely dream. I'll cheer you on. The paper said inflation has finally entered its last phase, so maybe now's the time to push.
lines.style: Fatherly encouragement followed by thoughtful musing, slower pacing on the second half.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。今日のコーヒー、サービスでもう一杯お出ししますね。応援してくださるお客様には感謝しかないです。
lines.en: Thank you so much. Let me serve you another cup on the house today. I'm truly grateful for customers who support me.
lines.style: Bright sincere gratitude, slight bow in the voice, professional warmth returning.
